notes:
Design system foundation + audit-suite bug fixes:

• New design direction live across the app: Plus Jakarta Sans, a light-first palette, one confident blue accent — replacing the old navy/gold theme (login screen keeps its old look for now, being rebuilt separately).
• Ageing (and Audit exports) now compute "days outstanding" as of the financial year end (31 March) instead of today's date.
• Purchase GST Summary: added an optional CGST/SGST/IGST/Cess ledger picker for charts that don't literally name these ledgers "CGST"/"SGST"/"IGST".
• Clause 27 (ITC): every auto-detected Duties & Taxes ledger now has an include/exclude checkbox.
• Clause 44: a Journal-booked expense with no distinct vendor ledger can now have its GST-registration bucket manually re-filed instead of defaulting to Unregistered with no way to fix it.
